yt_title: What a 40% chance of rain really means | Myth-Buster #1
text: What does a 40% chance of rain really mean? Not rain for 40% of the day. It's a 4 in 10 chance your spot gets measurable rain (at least 0.01 inch) during that forecast period. Keep an umbrella in the car. laporteweathernow.com #WeatherTips #LaPorte

yt_title: Lake-effect snow: why one town gets buried | Myth-Buster #4
text: How can La Porte get buried while Chicago stays sunny? Cold air crosses warmer lake water, picks up heat and moisture, rises, and drops snow in narrow bands downwind of the lake. One town gets buried; the next gets a dusting. laporteweathernow.com #LakeEffect #LaPorte #Snow
